superseded_attempt.defect: producer defect, not a platform fault: the attempt-1 producer required vkGetMemoryFdPropertiesKHR to succeed before any import. The installed Mesa implements that query for DMA_BUF only — for OPAQUE_FD it returns VK_ERROR_INVALID_EXTERNAL_HANDLE (-1000072003) even on the SAME device that exported the fd (physically observed; scratch diagnostic retained in the correction commit message trail). The Vulkan spec makes the query optional; for opaque_fd the destination buffer is created with VkExternalMemoryBufferCreateInfo chained, so its own memoryRequirements.memoryTypeBits already reflects importability, and vkAllocateMemory validates the import itself.
